title: Find a person's accounts through a membership index
description:
As a site that checks accounts on every sign-in, I want account lookups to scale beyond 256 accounts in total.

Feature: Find a person's accounts through a membership index
  Scenario: Many accounts in the system
    Given more than 256 canonical account documents
    When a person's accounts or directory are listed
    Then only that person's candidate accounts are read and each is rechecked against its canonical document

  Scenario: Rebuild from canonical files
    Given the index is missing or stale
    When it is rebuilt from canonical account documents
    Then listings match a full scan and the index never grants access by itself

Today list and directory read every account document per call and fail above 256 accounts. Canonical files stay the authority; the index is supplemental.
